questions.question: Four point charges +q, +q, −q, and −q are placed at the four vertices of a square of side length a. The total electrostatic potential energy of the system is: (q = 5 μC, a = 0.5 m)
questions.explanation: Arrangement: +q at (0,0), +q at (a,0), −q at (a,a), −q at (0,a). 6 pairs: 4 sides (distance a), 2 diagonals (distance a√2). U = k/a × [q²−q²+q²−q²−q²−q²] = −2kq²/a = −2(9×10⁹)(25×10⁻¹²)/0.5 = −0.9 J.

questions.question: A battery of emf 20 V and internal resistance 2 Ω drives current through R₁=4 Ω in series with parallel R₂=8 Ω and R₃=8 Ω. The current through R₂ is:
questions.explanation: R_parallel = (8×8)/(8+8) = 4 Ω. R_total = 4+4+2 = 10 Ω. I_total = 20/10 = 2 A. V_parallel = 2×4 = 8 V. I_R₂ = 8/8 = 1 A.

questions.question: Two long parallel wires separated by 25 cm carry currents of 10 A and 4 A in opposite directions. The force per unit length between them is: (μ₀/4π = 10⁻⁷ T·m/A)
questions.explanation: F/L = μ₀I₁I₂/(2πd) = (2×10⁻⁷)(10)(4)/(0.25) = 3.2×10⁻⁵ N/m. Opposite currents repel.
